title: Odd weight partial sum verifier
statement: For each natural number $m$, define a verifier with $m+2$ Boolean input positions, $m+1$ Boolean proof positions, and three query positions. It samples uniformly from the seed set consisting of two Boolean seeds and one seed for each index $k<m$. On the false seed it queries input positions $0$ and $1$ and proof position $0$; on the true seed it queries the last proof position and leaves the other two query positions unanswered; on seed $k$ it queries proof position $k$, input position $k+2$, and proof position $k+1$. It applies the corresponding transcript acceptance rule.
hypotheses_covered: Uniform sampling over the seed set
